class.name: JSBSimFDM
class.brief_description: One JSBSim flight dynamics model: loads an aircraft, sets the initial condition, trims, steps and gives access to JSBSim properties.
class.description: Wraps a JSBSim flight dynamics executive (JSBSim 1.3.3). It is the low-level interface: load a model with [method load_model], set the initial condition with [method set_initial_position], [method set_initial_orientation] and [method set_initial_airspeed], apply it with [method run_ic] (or [method reset]), optionally [method trim], then call [method step] and read or write properties with [method get_property] and [method set_property]. Most games use [JSBSimAircraft], which owns an [JSBSimFDM], steps it at a fixed rate and places a node in the scene; use [method JSBSimAircraft.get_fdm] to reach it. Errors never crash the game. JSBSim exceptions are caught, reported with [method @GlobalScope.push_error] and kept in [method get_last_error]; methods that can fail return [code]false[/code] (or 0 / an empty value). Units follow JSBSim's property names: [code]-ft[/code], [code]-fps[/code], [code]-kts[/code], [code]-deg[/code], [code]-rad[/code] and so on, so [method get_property] and [method set_property] values are in whatever unit the property name says (feet, not metres, for [code]position/h-agl-ft[/code]). The convenience methods of this class use degrees, metres and knots as documented on each of them. [codeblock] var fdm := JSBSimFDM.new() if fdm.load_model("J3Cub"): fdm.set_initial_position(41.0, 29.0, 1000.0) # degrees, degrees, metres above the ellipsoid fdm.set_initial_orientation(90.0, 0.0, 0.0) # heading, pitch, roll in degrees fdm.set_initial_airspeed(70.0) # calibrated knots fdm.run_ic() fdm.start_engines() fdm.trim() fdm.step(120) # one second at the default 120 Hz print(fdm.get_property("velocities/vc-kts")) else: push_error(fdm.get_last_error()) [/codeblock]

method.name: extract_data_dir
method.description: Copies the [code]res://[/code] data folder [param res_dir] to [code]user://jsbsim/<name>-<fingerprint>/[/code] and returns its absolute OS path. The fingerprint is derived from the names and MD5 sums of the files, so an unchanged folder is extracted once and reused. [method load_model] does this automatically when the data folder only exists inside an exported [code].pck[/code]; call this method to extract ahead of time. Returns an empty string and pushes an error if the folder cannot be listed or written.

method.name: get_data_path
method.description: Returns the absolute OS path JSBSim reads its data from (the extracted copy in [code]user://[/code] in exported games). Empty before a successful [method load_model].

method.name: get_debug_level
method.description: Returns JSBSim's global verbosity level set by [method set_debug_level]. The default is 0.

method.name: get_dt
method.description: Returns the JSBSim time step in seconds. Returns 0.0 and pushes an error if no model is loaded.

method.name: get_jsbsim_version
method.description: Returns the version of the bundled JSBSim library, for example [code]"1.3.3"[/code].

method.name: get_last_error
method.description: Returns the message of the last error of this object (a failed load, run, trim, step or property write), or an empty string. [method load_model] clears it.

method.name: get_log_level
method.description: Returns the minimum level of JSBSim messages sent to the Godot output, as set by [method set_log_level]. The default is [constant LOG_WARN].

method.name: get_model_name
method.description: Returns the name of the loaded model as JSBSim reports it, or an empty string if no model is loaded.

method.name: get_property
method.description: Returns the value of the JSBSim property [param name] (for example [code]"velocities/vc-kts"[/code]), in the unit given by the property name. Pushes an error and returns 0.0 if no model is loaded or the property does not exist; check with [method has_property] first when the name comes from user input.

method.name: get_property_names
method.description: Returns the names of the properties of the loaded model. If [param filter] is not empty, only names containing it (case-sensitive) are returned. The access flags JSBSim lists after the name are removed. Returns an empty array and pushes an error if no model is loaded.

method.name: get_sim_time
method.description: Returns the simulation time in seconds since the last [method reset] (the sum of the steps done). Returns 0.0 and pushes an error if no model is loaded.

method.name: has_property
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the loaded model has a property called [param name]. Names JSBSim cannot parse (containing spaces, starting with a digit) are not properties. Returns [code]false[/code] if no model is loaded.

method.name: is_loaded
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] after a successful [method load_model].

method.name: load_model
method.description: Loads the aircraft [param aircraft] (the name of a folder under [code]aircraft/[/code] and of its XML file, for example [code]"J3Cub"[/code]) from the data folder [param data_dir]. The data folder contains [code]aircraft/[/code] and optionally [code]engine/[/code] and [code]systems/[/code]; it can be a [code]res://[/code] path or an absolute path. A previously loaded model is discarded. In an exported game a [code]res://[/code] folder inside the [code].pck[/code] is extracted to [code]user://jsbsim/[/code] first (see [method extract_data_dir]). Returns [code]false[/code] on failure; the reason is in [method get_last_error] and the JSBSim messages in the output. The default [param data_dir] is [code]res://addons/jsbsim/data[/code].

method.name: reset
method.description: Restarts the model from the initial condition and sets the simulation time to 0. Returns [code]false[/code] on failure. Does nothing and pushes an error if no model is loaded.

method.name: resolve_data_dir
method.description: Returns the absolute OS path of the data folder [param data_dir]: the folder itself if it exists on disk, otherwise (for a [code]res://[/code] folder inside an exported [code].pck[/code]) the extracted copy from [method extract_data_dir]. Returns an empty string and pushes an error if it cannot be found.

method.name: run_ic
method.description: Applies the initial condition set with [method set_initial_position], [method set_initial_orientation] and [method set_initial_airspeed] and initializes the model. Returns [code]false[/code] on failure. Call it before the first [method step].

method.name: set_debug_level
method.description: Sets JSBSim's own verbosity (its [code]debug_lvl[/code] bit mask) for all models, [code]0[/code] being silent (the default) and [code]1[/code] normal console output such as the model summary and the trim report. It applies to models loaded afterwards.

method.name: set_dt
method.description: Sets the JSBSim time step in seconds. [param dt] must be greater than 0, otherwise an error is pushed and nothing changes. [JSBSimAircraft] sets the time step from its [member JSBSimAircraft.rate] before every step, so changing it on the [JSBSimFDM] of an aircraft node has no lasting effect.

method.name: set_initial_airspeed
method.description: Sets the initial [b]calibrated[/b] airspeed in knots. Takes effect with [method run_ic] or [method reset].

method.name: set_initial_orientation
method.description: Sets the initial true heading, pitch and roll in degrees. Takes effect with [method run_ic] or [method reset].

method.name: set_initial_position
method.description: Sets the initial geodetic [param latitude] and [param longitude] in degrees and [param height] in metres above the WGS84 ellipsoid. Takes effect with [method run_ic] or [method reset]. [b]Note:[/b] This is not JSBSim's [code]ic/h-sl-ft[/code]; the height is converted so that the geodetic height of the start matches [param height].

method.name: set_log_level
method.description: Sets the minimum [enum LogLevel] of JSBSim messages sent to the Godot output; lower ones are dropped. JSBSim errors and fatal errors go to [method @GlobalScope.push_error], warnings to [method @GlobalScope.push_warning], everything else to [method @GlobalScope.print]. Console output JSBSim writes as plain text (see [method set_debug_level]) is always printed. The setting is global for all models and defaults to [constant LOG_WARN].

method.name: set_property
method.description: Sets the JSBSim property [param name] to [param value], in the unit given by the property name. Only existing properties can be set: an unknown name pushes an error and returns [code]false[/code], so a typo does not create a new, unused property. Returns [code]false[/code] and sets [method get_last_error] if JSBSim throws while applying the value.

method.name: start_engines
method.description: Starts all engines in the running state (not cranking). Does nothing and pushes an error if no model is loaded.

method.name: step
method.description: Advances the model by [param count] time steps (see [method get_dt]) and returns the number of steps done, which is less than [param count] if JSBSim stops or fails (the reason is in [method get_last_error] if it threw).

method.name: trim
method.description: Trims the aircraft for the current initial condition using the JSBSim trim [param mode] (a [enum TrimMode] value). Returns [code]true[/code] on success. Returns [code]false[/code] and sets [method get_last_error] if the trim does not converge or the mode is not valid. Call it after [method run_ic] and [method start_engines].

constants.constant: JSBSim's longitudinal trim: angle of attack, throttle and elevator are adjusted until the vertical, forward and pitch accelerations are zero (wings level, no lateral axes).

JSBSim's full trim: the longitudinal trim plus bank angle, aileron, rudder and sideslip, so all linear and angular accelerations are zero. The default of [method trim] and the mode [JSBSimAircraft] uses at the start.
JSBSim's ground trim: altitude, pitch and bank are adjusted until the aircraft rests on its landing gear. [JSBSimAircraft] uses it when [member JSBSimAircraft.start_on_ground] is on.
JSBSim's pull-up trim: the longitudinal trim at a target load factor (JSBSim's [code]SetTargetNlf()[/code], not exposed by this class). Passed to JSBSim unchanged; the node classes do not use it.
JSBSim's steady turn trim. Passed to JSBSim unchanged; the node classes do not use it.
Level of JSBSim's most detailed messages (JSBSim's bulk level). Printed to the Godot output.
Level of JSBSim's debug messages. Printed to the Godot output.
Level of informational messages, for example the files the model loads. Printed to the Godot output.
Level of warnings. Pushed with [method @GlobalScope.push_warning]. The default minimum level.
Level of fatal errors. Pushed with [method @GlobalScope.push_error].
